changelog: Sales lead page: the last interaction now sits right under the follow-up, the trial-end, contract-end, win-back and estimated-value panels share a grid instead of each taking a full-width row, the follow-up and the interaction log each say what they are for (what comes next vs. what already happened, with a visible label on the interaction date), and "On your book since" reads "Assigned to you on" with a hint that it is not the trial start (#3652, #3653, #3654).

en: Lead page: the last interaction is shown right under the follow-up, the date and value panels sit side by side, and every section says what it is for.
tr: Müşteri adayı sayfası: son etkileşim takibin hemen altında, tarih ve değer kutuları yan yana; her bölüm ne için olduğunu söylüyor.
de: Lead-Seite: Die letzte Interaktion steht direkt unter dem Follow-up, Datums- und Wertfelder stehen nebeneinander, und jeder Bereich sagt, wofür er da ist.
